snippet.title: Flesh & Wire - Official Announcement Trailer | IGN Fan Fest 2026
snippet.description:
From Running With Scissors, here's your look at the Flesh & Wire announcement trailer for the upcoming first-person shooter that delves into the psychological horror roots of the Postal series. Venture into the twisted reality as Angel, a hapless victim suddenly swept up in a fever dream of conspiracy and blood as she seeks answers and vengeance against the crazed gunman who changed her life forever. Flesh & Wire will be available on Steam, Steam Deck, GOG, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) in 2027.

#IGN #FanFest
